issues.title: National AIDS Authority rejects ‘viral’ claims of HIV outbreak in Cambodia
issues.title_en: National AIDS Authority rejects ‘viral’ claims of HIV outbreak in Cambodia
issues.summary: PHNOM PENH: The National AIDS Authority has categorically rejected social media claims that Cambodia is experiencing an uptick of HIV infections. It highlighted that the number of new infections in the Kingdom continues to decline and offered statistics to support this.
